brief:
Hamas and the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine have called for the widest national consensus on elections for the Palestinian Legislative Council and National Council, Shehab Wire reported. The joint appeal marks a coordinated effort by two major Palestinian factions to build agreement on electoral procedures and institutional frameworks.

The call comes as Palestinian political movements engage in broader discussions over restructuring key governing bodies. Divisions among Palestinian factions have long complicated efforts to organize elections for the legislative body and the Palestine National Council, which serves as the highest Palestinian decision-making authority.
